title: Puzzle2d Node Selection Latency
description: Node click selection takes up to 4s especially in another active window. Fix selection hot path.
summary:
Fixed runtime crash: `Puzzle2dPlayPaneCanvas` called `usePuzzle2dPlaySelection` but only the document side panel was wrapped in `Puzzle2dPlaySelectionContext` after the applyCanvasSelection refactor. Selection context now wraps the full play shell (canvases + panels). Removed redundant per-panel provider from document tab definition.

Reduced duplicate Three.js warning for 2d play dev: aligned `puzzle/2d/play/vite.config.ts` with 3d play (single `three` alias + resolve.dedupe + optimizeDeps).

Tests: framework/playground/renderer/react 15/15; puzzle/2d/play 9/9.
